name: Space Invaders
short: Classic arcade shooter in TypeScript + Phaser.
desc: Classic arcade shooter built with TypeScript + Phaser.

name: Oregon Beach App
short: Picks the best Oregon coast beach right now from live NWS weather and drive time.
desc: Finds the best Oregon coast beach right now using NWS weather and driving distance.

name: Dino Poop
short: Territory-paint game where personality-driven dinos claim the board with blocking trails.
desc: Territory-paint game - dinos leave solid trails that claim the board and block movement, including their own. AI dinos are personality-driven.

name: Battle Bots
short: AI personality dueling arena with batch simulation and per-matchup stats.
desc: AI personality simulation arena — configurable agent flavors, equal-weighted matchups, batch simulation with stats.

name: Pack Hunt
short: Asymmetric predator/prey simulation - a wolf pack hunts a deer across an open field.
desc: Asymmetric predator/prey simulation - wolves hunt deer with different action sets and win conditions.

name: Card Table
short: Six-seat Texas Hold'em simulator where every player is a configurable AI personality.
desc: Six-seat card betting simulator - every player is a configurable AI personality, with per-seat stats.

name: Beach Finder
short: Finds the best beaches near you anywhere, ranked 0-100 on live weather.
desc: Find the best beaches near you, anywhere - live weather, ranked 0-100. Global cousin of the Oregon Beach App.

name: War Sim
short: 500-actor battle simulator with ballistics, cover and melee. Same seed, same battle.
desc: Large-field battle simulator - 500 personality-driven actors, unit-level personalities, simulated ballistics, cover and melee. Same seed, same battle.

name: Pack Hunt 3D
short: Pack Hunt in 3D - the same hunt with energy and gaits, in Godot 4 and WebAssembly.
desc: Pack Hunt in 3D - the same wolves and deer with an energy and gait model, on an orbitable field. A second, independent implementation in Godot 4 / GDScript, exported to WebAssembly.

name: Pack Hunt Brains
short: Describe the herd and the pack in plain English; Claude compiles both and runs them.
desc: Tell the deer herd and the wolf pack what to do, in plain English. Claude compiles each side into a small behaviour language and the simulation runs them against each other - the language picks actions, the energy model decides what they cost.

name: War Sim (Godot)
short: War Sim rebuilt in Godot 4 and WebAssembly - the same battle, a second engine.
desc: War Sim in Godot 4 / GDScript, exported to WebAssembly - a second, independent implementation of the same 500-actor battle, deterministic by seed.
